notes.title: Version 1.4.1
notes.notes:
Bugfix

In certain cases, the sleigh didn't show up correctly in the sleigh minigame this has been fixed.
Having Jackie Frost had her show in sleigh ride when not supposed to, this has been fixed.
If you wanted to redo the sleigh minigame, you would sometimes drop a present. This has been fixed.

Optimization

Some performance optimizations

notes.title: Version 1.4
notes.notes:
Grammar

"Many of our friends came help to find the thief" has been revised to "many of our friends came to help find the thief"

Graphics

Fixed light probes appearing during loading screens

Optimization

Improved preload functions for more optimized game performance
Reduced all loading times and amounts

UI

When asked about donation amount, you now see a small counter with current money
Improved menus for buying items

notes.title: Version 1.31
notes.notes:
Bugfix

Tooth Fairy was missing in the ending, this has been fixed


Event

Krampus has left Kemivieska

notes.title: Version 1.3
notes.notes:
Audio

Lowered volume for the song at the tavern
There was needless silence at the start of Frosty's first line, this has been removed
Part of Jack's speech was cut off, this lost portion has been restored

Bugfix 

If Timmy told a joke, while talking to someone this would cut off the voice line; this has been fixed
You could walk on decorations in the Santa's workshop, this has been fixed
You can no longer push boulders from the 1st floor while on 2nd floor

Graphics

Added Display Name for "Frosty's Home"
Corrected position of after party's loot drops to fit the UI
Corrected position of the numbers in level up after party UI
Place Name now has a zoom effect
Centered Place name

Gameplay

Added a sign into the very end of the roof of Roaring Caverns. If going all the way to the sign, you'll be rewarded with nuts.

Grammar

Changed "little that they have" to "Little that they do have"
Changed "to these kids" to "for these kids"

Label

Added "Healing Spa" label to the door at the Spa
Added "Save Point" label to the crystals

Lore

Added text to the letter Frosty had been writing to his home
Added a small message if you go all the way across the whole roof of Roaring Caverns

UI

Names for the actions in battles are now centered

notes.title: Krampus limited Time Event and Version 1.2
notes.notes:
Krampus has arrived to Kemivieska!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39147815/2efe16eb795774bfa4207859e566823a748b8e55.jpg

If you talk to Krampus, she'll give you Krampus Mask, some money and teach your magical user (Frosty or Jackie Frost, whoever you choose) an Unique spell; Quantum Leap.

Krampus can be found in Kemivieska until January 1st of 2021. Then she'll leave, only to come back again during the Christmas.

Version 1.2 Patch

Bugfix

Timmy could tell a joke when talking to someone else or him, this has been fixed
From the second floor, you could receive a sound effect of opening a chest on the first floor even though the was impossible to open from second floor. This has been fixed to avoid the misleading audio information to the player.
Using Quantum Leap crystal and then returning via return portal made it snow in Roaring Caverns, this has been fixed

Event

Krampus has come to the city of Kemivieska and shall reward you with a Krampus Mask, some money and teaching either Frosty or Jackie Frost an unique spell; Quantum Leap. Krampus will remain until January 1st, then she'll leave until 2021 Christmas.

Gameplay

You can now map the controls of Gamepad to your liking
Orphanage lady could block access to the rest of the orphanage, now her pathfinding sticks her to the single room 
Monsters can no longer attack you from the first floor, while you're on the second floor
Jackie Frost now follows you around on the map, if you recruit her

Grammar

"Hey brother!" changed to "Hey there brother!"

Graphics

Reduced the quantity of visual messages of "Inner Sanctum" 
Added a lot more snow across various objects in Kemiveiska including but not limited to; Windows, bridges and plants
Changed the water at Kemivieska to a more suitable snow edged water

Lore

Renamed generic "House" as "Frosty's Home"

Mapping 

Added blocking objects in Kemivieska to allow future content become accessible later in the game's lifespan

UI
Changed the Skills U

notes.title: Version 1.12
notes.notes:
Balance

Lowered Blizzard's damage to 2 times Wisdom (was 3)

Bugfix

Getting haircut could cause screen to stay black, this has been fixed
Talking to Molly again after giving her cocoa had missing voice lines, this has been fixed
Bath attendant had wrong boolean check and didn't play her voice lines, this has been fixed
You could walk on a certain specific spot at wall in the Banquet Hall, this has been fixed
You could see a present that had been claimed in second floor of Roaring Caverns, this has been fixed
Having haircut DLC active had the voice acting missing when checking out orphanage's money, this has been fixed
You could interact with a lever from second floor of ice cave to flip it multiple times, this has been fixed

Gameplay

The game now has after battle victory  party

notes.title: Version 1.11
notes.notes:
Bugfix

Resetting the sleigh ride minigame didn't reset score counter, allowing impossibly high scores that could potentially even break the game. This has been fixed.
Replacement Santa achievement didn't unlock in some situations, this has been fixed
